email.body1:
John, with FloQast past 3,000 customers and partnerships like PwC Belgium fueling demand, the bottleneck on growth is rarely signal anymore.

It is the lag between a buying signal firing and a rep acting on it, which quietly caps how much pipeline the same team can produce. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up the moment a signal hits, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a signal play for FloQast off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
John, quick follow-up for FloQast.

At your scale, most RevOps leaders can see leads stacking up but cannot prove where outbound leaks between signal, send, and CRM. That hidden gap quietly caps efficiency just as the team grows and demand keeps climbing.

Worth 15 minutes? I will walk you through a teardown of your current outbound and three specific things I would change. Our best practices alone usually lift response rates 50 to 70 percent.
email.body3:
John, last bit of proof for FloQast.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how FloQast's reply rate likely compares to peer growth-stage SaaS teams. Want to hop on a quick call and I will walk you through it?
